rationale: full_content is long-form text — canonical vector embedding use case.
review_text is long user-generated content — semantic similarity search.
abstract and body are scholarly long text — vector similarity retrieval.
description is a long job posting text — candidates search semantically.
content is helpdesk article body text — keyword/semantic FAQ search.
body is full blog post content — semantic search and recommendation.
contract_text is dense legal prose — semantic clause retrieval.
clinical_note is long unstructured clinical text — semantic retrieval for diagnosis support.
syllabus and description are long educational text — semantic course search.
content is full news article body — topic similarity and search.
Self-contained entity, no FKs, short text fields — document store.
Flat user entity with mixed field types and no FKs — document store.
Product entity with mixed text/numeric attributes and no FKs — document store.
Reference/config entity with no FKs and mixed short fields — document store.
Key-value config entity, no FKs, no relational structure — document store.
Self-contained inventory item entity with no FK references — document store.
Pure lookup/reference table with no FKs — document store.
Event entity with short descriptive fields and no FKs — document store.
Self-contained entity with no FKs and varied attributes — document store. Medium because fleet management often uses relational.
Reference document entity with no FKs. Medium because rates could also go relational for time-series querying.
Pure junction table with 2 FKs — canonical graph edge.
Social graph follower/followee relationship — pure graph edge.
Product-to-category many-to-many mapping — graph relationship.
RBAC junction table — role-to-permission graph is a natural fit.
Many-to-many supplier-to-product supply chain mapping — graph.
DAG of course dependencies — acyclic directed graph, natural for Neo4j.
Patient-to-doctor assignment — bipartite graph relationship.
Self-referencing FK (manager->employee) — tree/hierarchy graph.
Symmetric social friendship graph — pure graph edge table.
Tag-to-resource junction. Medium — could also stay relational if tag filtering via SQL is primary use case.
Transactional record with status/priority enum-like fields — SQL filtering.
Financial transaction table — numeric aggregation, exact-match, audit trail.
Payroll record with numeric salary/deduction fields — exact aggregation.
Structured audit/operational log with status codes and timestamps — SQL aggregation.
Stock movement ledger — insert-only append log, numeric quantities, SQL SUM.
Pricing/plan lookup table — numeric-heavy, exact-match for billing engine.
HR operational table — date ranges, status workflow, numeric days — SQL reporting.
Line-item transactional table — numeric price/qty, JOIN to orders — pure relational.
Daily attendance timestamps — temporal/numeric, exact-match, GROUP BY reporting.
System audit trail — append-only, timestamp-ordered, compliance queries — relational.
